snippet.description:
Struggling to write the introduction to your UPSC Mains answers? Don't waste precious minutes trying to frame the perfect opening!

In this video, learn a simple UPSC answer writing hack: pick a relevant keyword from the question, write its definition, and use it as your introduction. You can also prepare definitions of important syllabus keywords in advance.

Remember, your introduction doesn't need to be extraordinary. Keep it relevant and concise, and focus your effort on the body of the answer, where your content and analysis matter most.
